The '''Utos system''' was an eight-body system near the [[Koornacht Cluster/Legends|Koornacht Cluster]], within the [[Farlax sector/Legends|Farlax sector]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. It contained the habitable [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Galantos]].
